definitions.explanation: A machine-readable code consisting of a pattern of black and white squares that can store more information than a traditional one-dimensional barcode. Commonly used for payments, ticketing, and quick access to websites.

examples.japanese: {二次元|にじげん}コード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧。
⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二次元|にじげん}コード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{込|こ}んで→読み込む：14247_yomikomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please scan the QR code with your smartphone.

examples.japanese: {支払|しはら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二次元|にじげん}コード⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧です。
examples.english: QR-code payment is convenient for payments.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦チラシ→チラシ：23406_chirashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二次元|にじげん}コード⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦アクセス→アクセス：10696_akusesu⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can access detailed information from the QR code on this flyer.

notes:
A formal/official term for what is commonly called a QR code. Composed of ⟦{二次元|にじげん}→二次元：11422_nijigen⟧ (two-dimensional) + ⟦コード→コード：00241_koodo⟧ (code). The term {二次元|にじげん}コード is often preferred in formal writing, government documents, and printed materials because "QR code" is a registered trademark of Denso Wave, though QRコード is also widely used in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二次元|にじげん}コード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧: to scan/read a QR code
- {二次元|にじげん}コード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{込|こ}む→読み込む：14247_yomikomu⟧: to scan a QR code (into a device)
- {二次元|にじげん}コード⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧: QR-code payment
- {二次元|にじげん}コード⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with a QR code attached
- {二次元|にじげん}コード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生成|せいせい}→生成：10895_seisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to generate a QR code

SIMILAR WORDS:
- QRコード: QR code — the common everyday term; same thing
- ⟦バーコード→バーコード：10282_baakoodo⟧: barcode — one-dimensional linear barcode (stripes only)
- {一次元|いちじげん}⟦コード→コード：00241_koodo⟧: one-dimensional code — the formal counterpart term for traditional barcodes

USAGE:
QR codes are extremely widespread in Japan, used for cashless payment systems (PayPay, LINE Pay, etc.), restaurant menus, event tickets, transit, and advertisements.
